        "description": "After fourteen years of wrongful imprisonment, merchant sailor Edmond Dantès escapes his grim island fortress. Thanks to a benevolent prison confidante who reveals the location of a hidden treasure, Dantès buys his way, unrecognized, into society. Adopting a new identity as the Count of Monte Cristo, he sets out to destroy the rivals who framed him for treason.
